Acrostic
Successive line initials spell a name, word, or phrase.
provenance: Conventional form data prepared for Inspire, 2026; conventional form facts checked 2026-10-13 against https://poets.org/glossary/acrostic . Rhyme letters and line counts are factual notation; no example poems copied. Poetry Foundation pages consulted through indexed search excerpts; Academy of American Poets pages consulted in full. Form descriptions are typical patterns, not claims that every poem uses them without variation.
